name: fa-plugin
description: Phase 1 Fundamental Analysis for NSE-listed stocks. Runs management integrity (10 pts), management skillset (4 pts), industry stage + Porter's 5 Forces (8 pts), balance sheet health (10 pts), P&L health (10 pts), cash flow health (7 pts), and return ratios (7 pts) — synthesized into a RAG-rated investor report saved as Markdown and PDF.
